Doctor Found Dead in Car in Jaipur

A resident doctor was found dead inside a locked car in Jaipur, sparking concerns about the safety of medical professionals. The incident has raised questions about the working conditions and security measures for doctors in India's healthcare sector. Authorities are investigating the cause of death and have appealed for information from the public. The incident highlights the need for improved safety protocols and support systems for medical staff.
